summary_en: FY8/26 final dividend raised to ¥11/share from ¥10/share. Annual dividend guidance for FY8/26 set at ¥21/share. Payout ratio maintained at 30% target. First interim dividend ¥10/share remains unchanged.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: ktk Inc. raised its FY8/26 final dividend forecast to ¥11 per share from the prior guidance of ¥10 per share, approved by the board on 5 August 2026. The company targets a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30%. As a result of the increase, the full-year FY8/26 dividend is now expected at ¥21 per share, comprising ¥10 per share paid in interim periods and ¥11 per share as the final dividend. The company stated that the revision reflects recent performance trends and financial position, with an aim to enhance stable and sustained profit returns to shareholders. The interim and first, second, and third quarter dividends remain at their previously announced levels.
